035    private static void FillPoints(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
036            int counter,
037            ArrayList<POINT2> points) {
038        points.clear();
039        for (int j = 0; j < counter; j++) {
040            points.add(pLinePoints[j]);
041        }
042    }

044    /**
045     * This is the interface function to CELineArray from clsRenderer2 for
046     * non-channel types
047     *
048     * @param lineType the line type
049     * @param pts the client points
050     * @param shapes the symbol ShapeInfo objects
051     * @param clipBounds the rectangular clipping bounds
052     * @param rev the Mil-Standard-2525 revision
053     */
054    public static ArrayList<POINT2> GetLineArray2(int lineType,
055            ArrayList<POINT2> pts,
056            ArrayList<Shape2> shapes,
057            Rectangle2D clipBounds,
058            int rev,
059            IPointConversion converter) {
060
061        ArrayList<POINT2> points = null;
062        try {
063            POINT2 pt = null;
064            POINT2[] pLinePoints2 = null;
065            POINT2[] pLinePoints = null;
066            int vblSaveCounter = pts.size();
067            //get the count from countsupport
068            int j = 0;
069            if (pLinePoints2 == null || pLinePoints2.length == 0)//did not get set above
070            {
071                pLinePoints = new POINT2[vblSaveCounter];
072                for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter; j++) {
073                    pt = (POINT2) pts.get(j);
074                    pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pt.x, pt.y, pt.style);
075                }
076            }
077            //get the number of points the array will require
078            int vblCounter = countsupport.GetCountersDouble(lineType, vblSaveCounter, pLinePoints, clipBounds, rev);
079
080            //resize pLinePoints and fill the first vblSaveCounter elements with the original points
081            if (vblCounter > 0) {
082                pLinePoints = new POINT2[vblCounter];
083            } else {
084                shapes = null;
085                return null;
086            }
087
088            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pLinePoints);
089
090            //safeguards added 2-17-11 after CPOF client was allowed to add points to autoshapes
091            if (vblSaveCounter > pts.size()) {
092                vblSaveCounter = pts.size();
093            }
094            if (vblSaveCounter > pLinePoints.length) {
095                vblSaveCounter = pLinePoints.length;
096            }
097
098            for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter; j++) {
099                pt = (POINT2) pts.get(j);
100                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pt.x, pt.y, pt.style);
101            }
102            //we have to adjust the autoshapes because they are instantiating with fewer points
103            points = GetLineArray2Double(lineType, pLinePoints, vblCounter, vblSaveCounter, shapes, clipBounds, rev, converter);
104
105        } catch (Exception exc) {
106            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetLineArray2",
107                    new RendererException("GetLineArray2 " + Integer.toString(lineType), exc));
108
109        }
110        return points;
111        //the caller can get points
112    }

114    /**
115     * A function to calculate the points for FORTL
116     *
117     * @param pLinePoints OUT - the points arry also used for the return points
118     * @param lineType
119     * @param vblSaveCounter the number of client points
120     * @return
121     */
122    private static int GetFORTLPointsDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
123            int lineType,
124            int vblSaveCounter) {
125        int nCounter = 0;
126        try {
127            int j = 0, k = 0, bolVertical = 0;
128            int lCount = 0;
129            double dLengthSegment = 0, dIncrement = 20;
130            ref<double[]> m = new ref();
131            POINT2[] pSpikePoints = null;
132            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(), pt1 = new POINT2();
133
134            lCount = countsupport.GetFORTLCountDouble(pLinePoints, lineType, vblSaveCounter);
135            int numGlyphs = 0;
136            double dGlyphSize = 0;
137
138            pSpikePoints = new POINT2[lCount];
139            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pSpikePoints);
140            switch (lineType) {
141                default:
142                    dIncrement = 20;
143                    break;
144            }
145            for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter - 1; j++) {
146                bolVertical = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], m);
147                dLengthSegment = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1]);
148                if (dLengthSegment / 20 < 1) {
149                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
150                    nCounter++;
151                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
152                    nCounter++;
153                    continue;
154                }
155                numGlyphs = (int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement);
156                //dGlyphSize=dIncrement/2;
157                dGlyphSize = 10;
158                dIncrement = (dLengthSegment / numGlyphs);
159                if (dIncrement > 25) {
160                    dIncrement = 25;
161                    numGlyphs = (int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement);
162                }
163
164                //for (k = 0; k < dLengthSegment / 20 - 1; k++)
165                for (k = 0; k < numGlyphs; k++) {
166                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement, 0);
167                    nCounter++;
168                    //pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 10, 0);
169                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - dIncrement / 2, 0);
170                    nCounter++;
171                    pt0 = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1]);
172                    //pt1 = lineutility.ExtendLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], 10);
173                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], dIncrement / 2);
174                    //the spikes
175                    if (pLinePoints[j].x > pLinePoints[j + 1].x) {
176                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 3, dGlyphSize);
177                        nCounter++;
178                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt1, 3, dGlyphSize);
179                        nCounter++;
180                    }
181                    if (pLinePoints[j].x < pLinePoints[j + 1].x) {
182                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 2, dGlyphSize);
183                        nCounter++;
184                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt1, 2, dGlyphSize);
185                        nCounter++;
186                    }
187                    if (pLinePoints[j].x == pLinePoints[j + 1].x) {
188                        if (pLinePoints[j].y < pLinePoints[j + 1].y) {
189                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 1, dGlyphSize);
190                            nCounter++;
191                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt1, 1, dGlyphSize);
192                            nCounter++;
193                        }
194                        if (pLinePoints[j].y > pLinePoints[j + 1].y) {
195                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 0, dGlyphSize);
196                            nCounter++;
197                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt1, 0, dGlyphSize);
198                            nCounter++;
199                        }
200                    }
201                    //pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 3], 10, 0);
202                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 3], dIncrement / 2, 0);
203                    nCounter++;
204                }//end for k
205                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
206                nCounter++;
207            }//end for j
208            for (j = 0; j < nCounter; j++) {
209                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[j]);
210            }
211
212            return nCounter;
213        } catch (Exception exc) {
214            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetFORTLPointsDouble",
215                    new RendererException("GetFORTLPointsDouble " + Integer.toString(lineType), exc));
216        }
217        return nCounter;
218    }

220    private static void CoordFEBADouble(
221            POINT2[] pLinePoints,
222            int vblCounter) {
223        try {
224            int j = 0;
225            POINT2[] pXLinePoints = new POINT2[4 * vblCounter / 32];
226            POINT2[] pNewLinePoints = new POINT2[vblCounter / 32];
227            POINT2[] pShortLinePoints = new POINT2[2 * vblCounter / 32];
228            POINT2[] pArcLinePoints = new POINT2[26 * vblCounter / 32];
229            double dPrinter = 1.0;
230            //end declarations
231            for (j = vblCounter / 32; j < vblCounter; j++) {
232                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);    //initialize the rest of pLinePoints
233                pLinePoints[j].style = 0;
234            }
235
236            for (j = 0; j < 4 * vblCounter / 32; j++) {
237                pXLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);   //initialization only for pXLinePoints
238                pXLinePoints[j].style = 0;
239            }
240
241            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter / 32; j++) //initialize pNewLinePoints
242            {
243                pNewLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
244                pNewLinePoints[j].style = 0;
245            }
246
247            for (j = 0; j < 2 * vblCounter / 32; j++) //initialize pShortLinePoints
248            {
249                pShortLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
250                pShortLinePoints[j].style = 0;
251            }
252
253            for (j = 0; j < 26 * vblCounter / 32; j++) //initialize pArcLinePoints
254            {
255                pArcLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
256                pArcLinePoints[j].style = 0;
257            }
258
259            //first get the X's
260            lineutility.GetXFEBADouble(pNewLinePoints, 10 * dPrinter, vblCounter / 32,//was 7
261                    pXLinePoints);
262
263            for (j = 0; j < 4 * vblCounter / 32; j++) {
264                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pXLinePoints[j]);
265            }
266
267            pLinePoints[4 * vblCounter / 32 - 1].style = 5;
268
269            for (j = 4 * vblCounter / 32; j < 6 * vblCounter / 32; j++) {
270                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pShortLinePoints[j - 4 * vblCounter / 32]);
271                pLinePoints[j].style = 5;       //toggle invisible lines between feba's
272            }
273
274            pLinePoints[6 * vblCounter / 32 - 1].style = 5;
275
276            //last, get the arcs
277            lineutility.GetArcFEBADouble(14.0 * dPrinter, pNewLinePoints,
278                    vblCounter / 32,
279                    pArcLinePoints);
280
281            for (j = 6 * vblCounter / 32; j < vblCounter; j++) {
282                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pArcLinePoints[j - 6 * vblCounter / 32]);
283            }
284
285        } catch (Exception exc) {
286            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "CoordFEBADouble",
287                    new RendererException("CoordFEBADouble", exc));
288        }
289    }

291    private static int GetATWallPointsDouble2(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
292            int lineType,
293            int vblSaveCounter) {
294        int nCounter = 0;
295        try {
296            int j = 0, k = 0;
297            int lCount = 0;
298            double dLengthSegment = 0, dIncrement = 0;
299            POINT2[] pSpikePoints = null;
300            POINT2 pt0;
301            double dSpikeSize = 0;
302            int limit = 0, numSpikes = 0;;
303
304            lCount = countsupport.GetFORTLCountDouble(pLinePoints, lineType, vblSaveCounter);
305            pSpikePoints = new POINT2[lCount];
306            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pSpikePoints);
307            pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
308            for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter - 1; j++) {
309                dLengthSegment = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1]);
310                dIncrement = 20;
311                dSpikeSize = 10;
312//  diagnostic
313                numSpikes = (int) Math.round((dLengthSegment - 10) / dIncrement);
314                dIncrement = dLengthSegment / numSpikes;
315                if (dIncrement > 25) {
316                    dIncrement = 25;
317                }
318                //limit = (int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement) - 1;
319                limit = numSpikes - 1;
320//                if (limit < 1) {
321//                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
322//                    nCounter++;
323//                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
324//                    nCounter++;
325//                    continue;
326//                }
327//  end diagnostic                
328                for (k = -1; k < limit; k++)//was k=0 to limit
329                {
330                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 30, 0);
331                    nCounter++;
332
333                    pt0 = lineutility.ExtendLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], dSpikeSize / 2);
334
335                    //the spikes
336                    if (pLinePoints[j].x > pLinePoints[j + 1].x) //extend above the line
337                    {
338                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pt0, 2, dSpikeSize);
339                    }
340                    if (pLinePoints[j].x < pLinePoints[j + 1].x) //extend below the line
341                    {
342                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pt0, 3, dSpikeSize);
343                    }
344                    if (pLinePoints[j].x == pLinePoints[j + 1].x) {
345                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pt0);
346                        if (pLinePoints[j].y < pLinePoints[j + 1].y) //extend left of line
347                        {
348                            pSpikePoints[nCounter].x = pt0.x - dSpikeSize;
349                        } else //extend right of line
350                        {
351                            pSpikePoints[nCounter].x = pt0.x + dSpikeSize;
352                        }
353                    }
354                    nCounter++;
355
356                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2], dSpikeSize, 0);
357                    nCounter++;
358                }
359                //use the original line point for the segment end point
360                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
361                pSpikePoints[nCounter].style = 0;
362                nCounter++;
363            }
364
365            for (j = 0; j < nCounter; j++) {
366                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[j]);
367            }
368
369        } catch (Exception exc) {
370            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetATWallPointsDouble",
371                    new RendererException("GetATWallPointsDouble", exc));
372        }
373        return nCounter;
374    }

376    public static int GetInsideOutsideDouble2(POINT2 pt0,
377            POINT2 pt1,
378            POINT2[] pLinePoints,
379            int vblCounter,
380            int index,
381            int lineType) {
382        int nDirection = 0;
383        try {
384            ref<double[]> m = new ref();
385            ref<double[]> m0 = new ref();
386
387            double b0 = 0;
388            double b2 = 0;
389
390            double b = 0;
391            double X0 = 0;      //segment midpoint X value
392            double Y0 = 0;      //segment midpoint Y value
393            double X = 0;       //X value of horiz line from left intercept with current segment
394            double Y = 0;       //Y value of vertical line from top intercept with current segment
395            int nInOutCounter = 0;
396            int j = 0, bolVertical = 0;
397            int bolVertical2 = 0;
398            int nOrientation = 0; //will use 0 for horiz line from left, 1 for vertical line from top
399            int extendLeft = 0;
400            int extendRight = 1;
401            int extendAbove = 2;
402            int extendBelow = 3;
403
404            int oppSegment = vblCounter - index - 3;    //used by BELT1 only
405            POINT2 pt2 = new POINT2();
406            //end declarations. will use this to determine the direction
407
408            //slope of the segment
409            bolVertical = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDouble(pt0, pt1, m0);
410            if (m0.value == null) {
411                return 0;
412            }
413            //get the midpoint of the segment
414            X0 = (pt0.x + pt1.x) / 2;
415            Y0 = (pt0.y + pt1.y) / 2;
416
417            if (lineType == TacticalLines.BELT1 && oppSegment >= 0 && oppSegment < vblCounter - 1) {
418                //get the midpoint of the opposite segment
419                X0 = (pLinePoints[oppSegment].x + pLinePoints[oppSegment + 1].x) / 2;
420                Y0 = (pLinePoints[oppSegment].y + pLinePoints[oppSegment + 1].y) / 2;
421                //must calculate the corresponding point on the current segment
422                //first get the y axis intercept of the perpendicular line for the opposite (short) segment
423                //calculate this line at the midpoint of the opposite (short) segment
424                b0 = Y0 + 1 / m0.value[0] * X0;
425                //the y axis intercept of the index segment
426                b2 = pt0.y - m0.value[0] * pt0.x;
427                if (m0.value[0] != 0 && bolVertical != 0) {
428                    //calculate the intercept at the midpoint of the shorter segment
429                    pt2 = lineutility.CalcTrueIntersectDouble2(-1 / m0.value[0], b0, m0.value[0], b2, 1, 1, 0, 0);
430                    X0 = pt2.x;
431                    Y0 = pt2.y;
432                }
433                if (m0.value[0] == 0 && bolVertical != 0) {
434                    X0 = (pLinePoints[oppSegment].x + pLinePoints[oppSegment + 1].x) / 2;
435                    Y0 = (pt0.y + pt1.y) / 2;
436                }
437                if (bolVertical == 0) {
438                    Y0 = (pLinePoints[oppSegment].y + pLinePoints[oppSegment + 1].y) / 2;
439                    X0 = (pt0.x + pt1.x) / 2;
440                }
441            }
442
443            //slope is not too small or is vertical, use left to right
444            if (Math.abs(m0.value[0]) >= 1 || bolVertical == 0) {
445                nOrientation = 0;       //left to right orientation
446                for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
447                    if (index != j) {
448                        //for BELT1 we only want to know if the opposing segment is to the
449                        //left of the segment (index), do not check other segments
450                        if (lineType == TacticalLines.BELT1 && oppSegment != j) //change 2
451                        {
452                            continue;
453                        }
454
455                        //if ((pLinePoints[j].y <= Y0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].y >= Y0) ||
456                        //      (pLinePoints[j].y >= Y0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].y <= Y0)) 
457                        if ((pLinePoints[j].y < Y0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].y > Y0)
458                                || (pLinePoints[j].y > Y0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].y < Y0)
459                                || (pLinePoints[j].y < Y0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].y == Y0)
460                                || (pLinePoints[j].y == Y0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].y < Y0)) {
461                            bolVertical2 = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], m);
462                            if (bolVertical2 == 1 && m.value[0] == 0) //current segment is horizontal, this should not happen
463                            {   //counter unaffected
464                                nInOutCounter++;
465                                nInOutCounter--;
466                            }
467                            //current segment is vertical, it's x value must be to the left
468                            //of the current segment X0 for the horiz line from the left to cross
469                            if (bolVertical2 == 0) {
470                                if (pLinePoints[j].x < X0) {
471                                    nInOutCounter++;
472                                }
473                            }
474
475                            //current segment is not horizontal and not vertical
476                            if (m.value[0] != 0 && bolVertical2 == 1) {
477                                //get the X value of the intersection between the horiz line
478                                //from the left and the current segment
479                                //b=Y0;
480                                b = pLinePoints[j].y - m.value[0] * pLinePoints[j].x;
481                                X = (Y0 - b) / m.value[0];
482                                if (X < X0) //the horizontal line crosses the segment
483                                {
484                                    nInOutCounter++;
485                                }
486                            }
487
488                        }       //end if
489                    }
490
491                }       //end for
492            } //end if
493            else //use top to bottom to get orientation
494            {
495                nOrientation = 1;       //top down orientation
496                for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
497                    if (index != j) {
498                        //for BELT1 we only want to know if the opposing segment is
499                        //above the segment (index), do not check other segments
500                        if (lineType == TacticalLines.BELT1 && oppSegment != j) {
501                            continue;
502                        }
503
504                        //if ((pLinePoints[j].x <= X0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].x >= X0) ||
505                        //  (pLinePoints[j].x >= X0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].x <= X0)) 
506                        if ((pLinePoints[j].x < X0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].x > X0)
507                                || (pLinePoints[j].x > X0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].x < X0)
508                                || (pLinePoints[j].x < X0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].x == X0)
509                                || (pLinePoints[j].x == X0 && pLinePoints[j + 1].x < X0)) {
510                            bolVertical2 = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], m);
511                            if (bolVertical2 == 0) //current segment is vertical, this should not happen
512                            {   //counter unaffected
513                                nInOutCounter++;
514                                nInOutCounter--;
515                            }
516                            //current segment is horizontal, it's y value must be above
517                            //the current segment Y0 for the horiz line from the left to cross
518                            if (bolVertical2 == 1 && m.value[0] == 0) {
519                                if (pLinePoints[j].y < Y0) {
520                                    nInOutCounter++;
521                                }
522                            }
523
524                            //current segment is not horizontal and not vertical
525                            if (m.value[0] != 0 && bolVertical2 == 1) {
526                                //get the Y value of the intersection between the vertical line
527                                //from the top and the current segment
528                                b = pLinePoints[j].y - m.value[0] * pLinePoints[j].x;
529                                Y = m.value[0] * X0 + b;
530                                if (Y < Y0) //the vertical line crosses the segment
531                                {
532                                    nInOutCounter++;
533                                }
534                            }
535                        }       //end if
536                    }
537                }       //end for
538            }
539
540            switch (nInOutCounter % 2) {
541                case 0:
542                    if (nOrientation == 0) {
543                        nDirection = extendLeft;
544                    } else {
545                        nDirection = extendAbove;
546                    }
547                    break;
548                case 1:
549                    if (nOrientation == 0) {
550                        nDirection = extendRight;
551                    } else {
552                        nDirection = extendBelow;
553                    }
554                    break;
555                default:
556                    break;
557            }
558            //reverse direction for ICING
559            switch (lineType) {
560                case TacticalLines.ICING:
561                    if (nDirection == extendLeft) {
562                        nDirection = extendRight;
563                    } else if (nDirection == extendRight) {
564                        nDirection = extendLeft;
565                    } else if (nDirection == extendAbove) {
566                        nDirection = extendBelow;
567                    } else if (nDirection == extendBelow) {
568                        nDirection = extendAbove;
569                    }
570                    break;
571                default:
572                    break;
573            }
574        } catch (Exception exc) {
575            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetInsideOutsideDouble2",
576                    new RendererException("GetInsideOutsideDouble2", exc));
577        }
578        return nDirection;
579    }

581    /**
582     * BELT1 line and others
583     *
584     * @param pLinePoints
585     * @param lineType
586     * @param vblSaveCounter
587     * @return
588     */
589    protected static int GetZONEPointsDouble2(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
590            int lineType,
591            int vblSaveCounter) {
592        int nCounter = 0;
593        try {
594            int j = 0, k = 0, n = 0;
595            int lCount = 0;
596            double dLengthSegment = 0;
597            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]), pt1 = null, pt2 = null, pt3 = null;
598            POINT2[] pSpikePoints = null;
599            int nDirection = 0;
600
601            lCount = countsupport.GetFORTLCountDouble(pLinePoints, lineType, vblSaveCounter);
602            pSpikePoints = new POINT2[lCount];
603            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pSpikePoints);
604            double remainder = 0;
605            for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter - 1; j++) {
606                pt1 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
607                pt2 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
608                //get the direction for the spikes
609                nDirection = GetInsideOutsideDouble2(pt1, pt2, pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter, (int) j, lineType);
610                dLengthSegment = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1]);
611                //reverse the direction for those lines with inward spikes
612                if (!(lineType == TacticalLines.BELT) && !(lineType == TacticalLines.BELT1)) {
613                    if (dLengthSegment < 20) {
614                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
615                        nCounter++;
616                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
617                        nCounter++;
618                        continue;
619                    }
620                }
621                switch (lineType) {
622                    case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
623                    case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
624                        switch (nDirection) {
625                            case 0:     //extend left
626                                nDirection = 1; //extend right
627                                break;
628                            case 1:     //extend right
629                                nDirection = 0; //extend left
630                                break;
631                            case 2:     //extend above
632                                nDirection = 3; //extend below
633                                break;
634                            case 3:     //extgend below
635                                nDirection = 2; //extend above
636                                break;
637                            default:
638                                break;
639                        }
640                        break;
641                    default:
642                        break;
643                }
644                n = (int) (dLengthSegment / 20);
645                remainder = dLengthSegment - n * 20;
646                for (k = 0; k < n; k++) {
647                    if (k > 0) {
648                        pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * 20 - remainder / 2, 0);//was +0
649                        pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * 20 - 10 - remainder / 2, 0);//was -10
650                    } else {
651                        pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * 20, 0);//was +0
652                        pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * 20 - 10, 0);//was -10
653                    }
654
655                    switch (lineType) {
656                        case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
657                        case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
658                        case TacticalLines.ZONE:
659                        case TacticalLines.BELT:
660                        case TacticalLines.BELT1:
661                        case TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE:
662                            pt0 = lineutility.ExtendLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], 5);
663                            break;
664                        case TacticalLines.STRONG:
665                        case TacticalLines.FORT:
666                            pt0 = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1]);
667                            break;
668                        default:
669                            break;
670                    }
671
672                    pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt1, pt2, pt0, nDirection, 10);
673                    //nCounter++;
674                    switch (lineType) {
675                        case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
676                        case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
677                        case TacticalLines.ZONE:
678                        case TacticalLines.BELT:
679                        case TacticalLines.BELT1:
680                        case TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE:
681                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2], 10, 0);
682                            break;
683                        case TacticalLines.STRONG:
684                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2]);
685                            break;
686                        case TacticalLines.FORT:
687                            pt3 = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2], 10, 0);
688                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt1, pt2, pt3, nDirection, 10);
689                            nCounter++;
690                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pt3);
691                            break;
692                        default:
693                            break;
694                    }
695                    //}
696                    nCounter++;
697                    //diagnostic
698                    if (lineType == TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE) {
699                        pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 4]);
700                    }
701                }//end for k
702                pSpikePoints[nCounter++] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
703                //nCounter++;
704            }//end for j
705            for (j = 0; j < nCounter; j++) {
706                if (lineType == (long) TacticalLines.OBSAREA) {
707                    pSpikePoints[j].style = 11;
708                }
709            }
710            if (lineType == (long) TacticalLines.OBSAREA) {
711                pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1].style = 12;
712            } else {
713                if (nCounter > 0) {
714                    pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1].style = 5;
715                }
716            }
717
718            for (j = 0; j < nCounter; j++) {
719                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[j]);
720                if (j == nCounter - 1) {
721                    if (lineType != (long) TacticalLines.OBSAREA) {
722                        pLinePoints[j].style = 5;
723                    }
724                }
725            }
726
727        } catch (Exception exc) {
728            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetZONEPointsDouble2",
729                    new RendererException("GetZONEPointsDouble2", exc));
730        }
731        return nCounter;
732    }

734    private static boolean IsTurnArcReversed(POINT2[] pPoints) {
735        try {
736            if (pPoints.length < 3) {
737                return false;
738            }
739
740            POINT2[] ptsSeize = new POINT2[2];
741            ptsSeize[0] = new POINT2(pPoints[0]);
742            ptsSeize[1] = new POINT2(pPoints[1]);
743            lineutility.CalcClockwiseCenterDouble(ptsSeize);
744            double d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptsSeize[0], pPoints[2]);
745
746            ptsSeize[0] = new POINT2(pPoints[1]);
747            ptsSeize[1] = new POINT2(pPoints[0]);
748            lineutility.CalcClockwiseCenterDouble(ptsSeize);
749            double dArcReversed = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptsSeize[0], pPoints[2]);
750
751            ptsSeize = null;
752            if (dArcReversed > d) {
753                return true;
754            } else {
755                return false;
756            }
757        } catch (Exception exc) {
758            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "IsTurnArcReversed",
759                    new RendererException("IsTurnArcReversed", exc));
760        }
761        return false;
762    }

764    private static void GetIsolatePointsDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
765            int lineType,
766            IPointConversion converter) {
767        try {
768            boolean reverseTurn = false;
769            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]), pt1 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[1]), pt2 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
770            if (pt0.x == pt1.x && pt0.y == pt1.y) {
771                pt1.x += 1;
772            }
773
774            POINT2 C = new POINT2(), E = new POINT2(), midPt = new POINT2();
775            int j = 0, k = 0, l = 0;
776            POINT2[] ptsArc = new POINT2[26];
777            POINT2[] midPts = new POINT2[7];
778            POINT2[] trianglePts = new POINT2[21];
779            POINT2[] pArrowPoints = new POINT2[3], reversepArrowPoints = new POINT2[3];
780            double dRadius = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
781            double dLength = Math.abs(dRadius - 20);
782            if (dRadius < 40) {
783                dLength = dRadius / 1.5;
784            }
785
786            double d = lineutility.MBRDistance(pLinePoints, 2);
787            POINT2[] ptsSeize = new POINT2[2];
788            POINT2[] savepoints = new POINT2[3];
789            for (j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
790                savepoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
791            }
792
793            if (pLinePoints.length >= 3) {
794                savepoints[2] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[2]);
795            }
796
797            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(ptsArc);
798            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(midPts);
799            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(trianglePts);
800            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pArrowPoints);
801            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(reversepArrowPoints);
802            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(ptsSeize);
803
804            if (d / 7 > maxLength) {
805                d = 7 * maxLength;
806            }
807            if (d / 7 < minLength) {  //was minLength
808                d = 7 * minLength;    //was minLength
809            }
810            //change due to outsized arrow in 6.0, 11-3-10
811            if (d > 140) {
812                d = 140;
813            }
814            //calculation points for the SEIZE arrowhead
815            //for SEIZE calculations
816            POINT2[] ptsArc2 = new POINT2[26];
817            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(ptsArc2);
818
819            E.x = 2 * pt1.x - pt0.x;
820            E.y = 2 * pt1.y - pt0.y;
821            ptsArc[0] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[1]);
822            ptsArc[1] = new POINT2(E);
823            if(converter != null)
824            {
825                ptsArc[0] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
826                ptsArc[1] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[1]);
827            }
828
829            lineutility.ArcArrayDouble(ptsArc, 0, dRadius, lineType, converter);
830            for (j = 0; j < 26; j++) {
831                ptsArc[j].style = 0;
832                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(ptsArc[j]);
833                pLinePoints[j].style = 0;
834            }
835            if (lineType != TacticalLines.OCCUPY) {
836                lineutility.GetArrowHead4Double(ptsArc[24], ptsArc[25], (int) d / 7, (int) d / 7, pArrowPoints, 0);
837            } else {
838                lineutility.GetArrowHead4Double(ptsArc[24], ptsArc[25], (int) d / 7, (int) (1.75 * d) / 7, pArrowPoints, 0);
839            }
840
841            pLinePoints[25].style = 5;
842
843            switch (lineType) {
844                case TacticalLines.CORDONKNOCK:
845                case TacticalLines.CORDONSEARCH:
846                case TacticalLines.ISOLATE:
847                    if (dRadius > 100) {
848                        dLength = 0.8 * dRadius;
849                    }
850                    for (j = 1; j <= 23; j++) {
851                        if (j % 3 == 0) {
852                            midPts[k].x = pt0.x - (long) ((dLength / dRadius) * (pt0.x - ptsArc[j].x));
853                            midPts[k].y = pt0.y - (long) ((dLength / dRadius) * (pt0.y - ptsArc[j].y));
854                            midPts[k].style = 0;
855                            trianglePts[l] = new POINT2(ptsArc[j - 1]);
856                            l++;
857                            trianglePts[l] = new POINT2(midPts[k]);
858                            l++;
859                            trianglePts[l] = new POINT2(ptsArc[j + 1]);
860                            trianglePts[l].style = 5;
861                            l++;
862                            k++;
863                        }
864                    }
865                    for (j = 26; j < 47; j++) {
866                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(trianglePts[j - 26]);
867                    }
868                    pLinePoints[46].style = 5;
869                    for (j = 47; j < 50; j++) {
870                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pArrowPoints[j - 47]);
871                        pLinePoints[j].style = 0;
872                    }
873                    break;
874                case TacticalLines.OCCUPY:
875                    midPt.x = (pt1.x + ptsArc[25].x) / 2;
876                    midPt.y = (pt1.y + ptsArc[25].y) / 2;
877                    lineutility.GetArrowHead4Double(midPt, ptsArc[25], (int) d / 7, (int) (1.75 * d) / 7, reversepArrowPoints, 0);
878                    for (j = 26; j < 29; j++) {
879                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pArrowPoints[j - 26]);
880                    }
881                    for (j = 29; j < 32; j++) {
882                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(reversepArrowPoints[j - 29]);
883                        pLinePoints[j].style = 0;
884                    }
885                    break;
886                case TacticalLines.SECURE:
887                    for (j = 26; j < 29; j++) {
888                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pArrowPoints[j - 26]);
889                        pLinePoints[j].style = 0;
890                    }
891                    pLinePoints[28].style = 5;
892                    break;
893
894                case TacticalLines.TURN:
895                    boolean changeArc = IsTurnArcReversed(savepoints); //change 1
896                    if (reverseTurn == true || changeArc == true) //swap the points
897                    {
898                        pt0.x = pt1.x;
899                        pt0.y = pt1.y;
900                        pt1.x = pt2.x;
901                        pt1.y = pt2.y;
902                    }
903
904                    ptsSeize[0] = new POINT2(pt0);
905                    ptsSeize[1] = new POINT2(pt1);
906
907                    dRadius = lineutility.CalcClockwiseCenterDouble(ptsSeize);
908
909                    C = new POINT2(ptsSeize[0]);
910                    E = new POINT2(ptsSeize[1]);
911                    ptsArc[0] = new POINT2(pt0);
912                    ptsArc[1] = new POINT2(E);
913                    lineutility.ArcArrayDouble(ptsArc, 0, dRadius, lineType, null);
914                    for (j = 0; j < 26; j++) {
915                        ptsArc[j].style = 0;
916                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(ptsArc[j]);
917                        pLinePoints[j].style = 0;
918                    }
919
920                    if (changeArc == true)//if(changeArc==false)    //change 1
921                    {
922                        lineutility.GetArrowHead4Double(ptsArc[1], pt0, (int) d / 7, (int) d / 7, pArrowPoints, 5);
923                    } else {
924                        lineutility.GetArrowHead4Double(ptsArc[24], pt1, (int) d / 7, (int) d / 7, pArrowPoints, 5);
925                    }
926
927                    pLinePoints[25].style = 5;
928
929                    for (j = 26; j < 29; j++) {
930                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pArrowPoints[j - 26]);
931                        pLinePoints[j].style = 9;
932                    }
933                    pLinePoints[28].style = 10;
934
935                    break;
936                case TacticalLines.RETAIN:
937                    for (j = 26; j < 29; j++) {
938                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pArrowPoints[j - 26]);
939                        pLinePoints[j].style = 0;
940                    }
941                    pLinePoints[28].style = 5;
942                    //get the extended points for retain
943                    k = 29;
944                    for (j = 1; j < 24; j++) {
945                        pLinePoints[k] = new POINT2(ptsArc[j]);
946                        pLinePoints[k].style = 0;
947                        k++;
948                        pLinePoints[k] = lineutility.ExtendLineDouble(pt0, ptsArc[j], (long) d / 7);
949                        pLinePoints[k].style = 5;
950                        k++;
951                    }
952
953                    break;
954                default:
955                    break;
956            }
957        } catch (Exception exc) {
958            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetIsolatePointsDouble",
959                    new RendererException("GetIsolatePointsDouble " + Integer.toString(lineType), exc));
960        }
961    }

963    /**
964     * @deprecated returns the location for the Dummy Hat
965     * @param pLinePoints
966     * @return
967     */
968    private static POINT2 getDummyHat(POINT2[] pLinePoints) {
969        POINT2 pt = null;
970        try {
971            int j = 0;
972            double minY = Double.MAX_VALUE;
973            double minX = Double.MAX_VALUE, maxX = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
974            int index = -1;
975            //get the highest point
976            for (j = 0; j < pLinePoints.length - 3; j++) {
977                if (pLinePoints[j].y < minY) {
978                    minY = pLinePoints[j].y;
979                    index = j;
980                }
981                if (pLinePoints[j].x < minX) {
982                    minX = pLinePoints[j].x;
983                }
984                if (pLinePoints[j].x > maxX) {
985                    maxX = pLinePoints[j].x;
986                }
987            }
988            pt = new POINT2(pLinePoints[index]);
989            double deltaMaxX = 0;
990            double deltaMinX = 0;
991            if (pt.x + 25 > maxX) {
992                deltaMaxX = pt.x + 25 - maxX;
993                pt.x -= deltaMaxX;
994            }
995            if (pt.x - 25 < minX) {
996                deltaMinX = minX - (pt.x - 25);
997                pt.x += deltaMinX;
998            }
999        } catch (Exception exc) {
1000            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "getDummyHat",
1001                    new RendererException("getDummyHat", exc));
1002        }
1003        return pt;
1004    }

1006    private static void AreaWithCenterFeatureDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints,

1010            //declarations
1011            int k = 0;
1012            POINT2 ptCenter = new POINT2();
1013            int fLength = 4;
1014            if (lineType == TacticalLines.AIRFIELD) {
1015                fLength = 5;
1016            }
1017            double d = lineutility.MBRDistance(pLinePoints, vblCounter - fLength);
1018            if (d > 350) {
1019                d = 350;
1020            }
1021
1022            for (k = 0; k < vblCounter; k++) {
1023                pLinePoints[k].style = 0;

1025            switch (lineType) {

1028                        d = 20;
1029                    }
1030                    if (d > 60) {

1032                    }
1033                    POINT2 ul = new POINT2();

1038
1039                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3] = lineutility.MidPointDouble(ur, ul, 0);
1040                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].x -= d / 2;//25;
1041                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].y -= d / 5;//10;

1045                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].x += d / 2;//25;
1046                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].y -= d / 5;//10;

1051                        d = 100;
1052                    }
1053                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 5] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
1054                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 5].style = 5;
1055                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4] = lineutility.CalcCenterPointDouble(pLinePoints, vblCounter - 6);
1056                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4].x -= d / 10;    //was 20
1057                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4].style = 0;
1058                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4]);
1059                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].x = pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4].x + d / 5;//was 10
1060                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].style = 5;
1061                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4]);
1062                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].y += d / 20;//was 40
1063                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].style = 0;
1064                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3]);
1065                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].y -= d / 20;//was 40
1066                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].style = 0;
1067                    break;
1068                case TacticalLines.DMA:
1069                    if (d < 50) {
1070                        d = 50;
1071                    }
1072                    if (lineType == (long) TacticalLines.DMA) {
1073                        for (k = 0; k < vblCounter - 4; k++) {
1074                            pLinePoints[k].style = 14;
1075                        }
1076                    }
1077                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
1078                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4].style = 5;
1079                    ptCenter = lineutility.CalcCenterPointDouble(pLinePoints, vblCounter - 4);
1080                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].x = ptCenter.x - d / 10;
1081                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].y = ptCenter.y;
1082                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].style = 18;
1083                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].x = ptCenter.x;
1084                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].y = ptCenter.y - d / 10;
1085                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].style = 18;
1086                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].x = ptCenter.x + d / 10;
1087                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].y = ptCenter.y;
1088                    break;
1089                case TacticalLines.DMAF:
1090                    if (d < 50) {
1091                        d = 50;
1092                    }
1093                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 4].style = 5;
1094                    ptCenter = lineutility.CalcCenterPointDouble(pLinePoints, vblCounter - 4);
1095                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].x = ptCenter.x - d / 10;
1096                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].y = ptCenter.y;
1097                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3].style = 18;
1098                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].x = ptCenter.x;
1099                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].y = ptCenter.y - d / 10;
1100                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2].style = 18;
1101                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].x = ptCenter.x + d / 10;
1102                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].y = ptCenter.y;
1103                    pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].style = 5;
1104                    break;
1105                default:
1106                    break;
1107            }
1108        } catch (Exception exc) {

1111        }

1114    private static int GetATWallPointsDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
1115            int lineType,
1116            int vblSaveCounter) {
1117        int nCounter = 0;
1118        try {
1119            int j = 0, k = 0;
1120            int lCount = 0;
1121            double dLengthSegment = 0, dIncrement = 0;
1122            POINT2[] pSpikePoints = null;
1123            POINT2 pt0;
1124            double dRemainder = 0, dSpikeSize = 0;
1125            int limit = 0;
1126            POINT2 crossPt1, crossPt2;
1127
1128            lCount = countsupport.GetFORTLCountDouble(pLinePoints, lineType, vblSaveCounter);
1129            pSpikePoints = new POINT2[lCount];
1130            switch (lineType) {
1131                case TacticalLines.CFG:
1132                case TacticalLines.CFY:
1133                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = pLinePoints[0];
1134                    pSpikePoints[nCounter].style = 0;
1135                    nCounter++;
1136                    break;
1137                default:
1138                    break;
1139            }
1140            for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter - 1; j++) {
1141                dLengthSegment = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1142                switch (lineType) {
1143                    case TacticalLines.UCF:
1144                    case TacticalLines.CF:
1145                    case TacticalLines.CFG:
1146                    case TacticalLines.CFY:
1147                        dIncrement = 60;
1148                        dSpikeSize = 20;
1149                        dRemainder = dLengthSegment / dIncrement - (double) ((int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement));
1150                        if (dRemainder < 0.75) {
1151                            limit = (int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement);
1152                        } else {
1153                            limit = (int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement) + 1;
1154                        }
1155                        break;
1156                    default:
1157                        dIncrement = 20;
1158                        dSpikeSize = 10;
1159                        limit = (int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement) - 1;
1160                        break;
1161                }
1162                if (limit < 1) {
1163                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = pLinePoints[j];
1164                    nCounter++;
1165                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = pLinePoints[j + 1];
1166                    nCounter++;
1167                    continue;
1168                }
1169
1170                for (k = 0; k < limit; k++) {
1171                    switch (lineType) {
1172                        case TacticalLines.CFG: //linebreak for dot
1173                            if (k > 0) {
1174                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement + 45, 0);
1175                                nCounter++;
1176                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement + 4, 5);     //+2
1177                                nCounter++;
1178                                //dot
1179                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 1, 20);
1180                                nCounter++;
1181                                //remainder of line
1182                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 7, 0);     //-4
1183                            } else {
1184                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 45, 0);
1185                            }
1186                            break;
1187                        case TacticalLines.CFY: //linebreak for crossed line
1188                            if (k > 0) {
1189                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement + 45, 0);
1190                                nCounter++;
1191                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement + 10, 5);    //+2
1192                                nCounter++;
1193                                //dot
1194                                //replace the dot with crossed line segment
1195                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pLinePoints[j + 1], 5, 0);
1196                                nCounter++;
1197                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pLinePoints[j + 1], 10, 5);
1198                                nCounter++;
1199                                crossPt1 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], 2, 5, 0);
1200                                crossPt2 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2], 3, 5, 5);
1201                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = crossPt1;
1202                                nCounter++;
1203                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = crossPt2;
1204                                nCounter++;
1205                                //remainder of line
1206                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 13, 0);    //-4
1207                            } else {
1208                                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 45, 0);
1209                            }
1210                            break;
1211                        default:
1212                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - 30, 0);
1213                            break;
1214                    }
1215                    if (lineType == TacticalLines.CF) {
1216                        pSpikePoints[nCounter].style = 0;
1217                    }
1218                    nCounter++;
1219                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement - dSpikeSize, 0);
1220
1221                    if (lineType == TacticalLines.CF
1222                            || lineType == TacticalLines.CFG
1223                            || lineType == TacticalLines.CFY) {
1224                        pSpikePoints[nCounter].style = 9;
1225                    }
1226
1227                    nCounter++;
1228                    pt0 = lineutility.ExtendLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], dSpikeSize / 2);
1229
1230                    //the spikes
1231                    if (pLinePoints[j].x > pLinePoints[j + 1].x) //extend above the line
1232                    {
1233                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pt0, 2, dSpikeSize);
1234                    }
1235                    if (pLinePoints[j].x < pLinePoints[j + 1].x) //extend below the line
1236                    {
1237                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1], pt0, 3, dSpikeSize);
1238                    }
1239                    if (pLinePoints[j].x == pLinePoints[j + 1].x) {
1240                        pSpikePoints[nCounter] = pt0;
1241                        if (pLinePoints[j].y < pLinePoints[j + 1].y) //extend left of line
1242                        {
1243                            pSpikePoints[nCounter].x = pt0.x - dSpikeSize;
1244                        } else //extend right of line
1245                        {
1246                            pSpikePoints[nCounter].x = pt0.x + dSpikeSize;
1247                        }
1248                    }
1249                    nCounter++;
1250
1251                    if (lineType == TacticalLines.CF
1252                            || lineType == TacticalLines.CFG
1253                            || lineType == TacticalLines.CFY) {
1254                        pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1].style = 9;
1255                    }
1256
1257                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 2], dSpikeSize, 0);
1258                    //need an extra point for these
1259                    switch (lineType) {
1260                        case TacticalLines.CF:
1261                            pSpikePoints[nCounter].style = 10;
1262                            break;
1263                        case TacticalLines.CFG:
1264                        case TacticalLines.CFY:
1265                            pSpikePoints[nCounter].style = 10;
1266                            nCounter++;
1267                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 3], dSpikeSize, 0);
1268                            break;
1269                        default:
1270                            break;
1271                    }
1272                    nCounter++;
1273                }
1274
1275                //use the original line point for the segment end point
1276                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = pLinePoints[j + 1];
1277                pSpikePoints[nCounter].style = 0;
1278                nCounter++;
1279            }
1280
1281            for (j = 0; j < nCounter; j++) {
1282                pLinePoints[j] = pSpikePoints[j];
1283            }
1284            pLinePoints[nCounter - 1].style = 5;
1285
1286        } catch (Exception exc) {
1287            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetATWallPointsDouble",
1288                    new RendererException("GetATWallPointsDouble " + Integer.toString(lineType), exc));
1289        }
1290        return nCounter;
1291    }

1293    private static int GetRidgePointsDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
1294            int lineType,
1295            int vblSaveCounter) {
1296        int nCounter = 0;
1297        try {
1298            int j = 0, k = 0;
1299            int lCount = 0;
1300            double dLengthSegment = 0, dIncrement = 20;
1301            ref<double[]> m = new ref();
1302            POINT2[] pSpikePoints = null;
1303            POINT2 pt0;
1304            double dSpikeSize = 20;
1305            int limit = 0;
1306            double d = 0;
1307            int bolVertical = 0;
1308
1309            m.value = new double[1];
1310            lCount = countsupport.GetFORTLCountDouble(pLinePoints, lineType, vblSaveCounter);
1311
1312            pSpikePoints = new POINT2[lCount];
1313            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pSpikePoints);
1314            //for(j=0;j<numPts2-1;j++)
1315            for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter - 1; j++) {
1316                bolVertical = lineutility.CalcTrueSlopeDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], m);
1317                dLengthSegment = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1318                limit = (int) (dLengthSegment / dIncrement);
1319                if (limit < 1) {
1320                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
1321                    nCounter++;
1322                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1323                    nCounter++;
1324                    continue;
1325                }
1326                for (k = 0; k < limit; k++) {
1327                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -k * dIncrement, 0);
1328                    nCounter++;
1329                    d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pLinePoints[j], pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1]);
1330                    pt0 = lineutility.ExtendLineDouble(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -d - dSpikeSize / 2);
1331
1332                    //the spikes
1333                    if (bolVertical != 0) //segment is not vertical
1334                    {
1335                        if (pLinePoints[j].x < pLinePoints[j + 1].x) //extend above the line
1336                        {
1337                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 2, dSpikeSize);
1338                        } else //extend below the line
1339                        {
1340                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 3, dSpikeSize);
1341                        }
1342                    } else //segment is vertical
1343                    {
1344                        if (pLinePoints[j + 1].y < pLinePoints[j].y) //extend left of the line
1345                        {
1346                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 0, dSpikeSize);
1347                        } else //extend right of the line
1348                        {
1349                            pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], pt0, 1, dSpikeSize);
1350                        }
1351                    }
1352                    nCounter++;
1353                    pSpikePoints[nCounter] = lineutility.ExtendLine2Double(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], -d - dSpikeSize, 0);
1354                    nCounter++;
1355                }
1356                pSpikePoints[nCounter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1357                nCounter++;
1358            }
1359
1360            for (j = 0; j < nCounter; j++) {
1361                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[j]);
1362            }
1363            for (j = nCounter; j < lCount; j++) {
1364                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pSpikePoints[nCounter - 1]);
1365            }
1366
1367        } catch (Exception exc) {
1368            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetRidgePointsDouble",
1369                    new RendererException("GetRidgePointsDouble " + Integer.toString(lineType), exc));
1370        }
1371        return nCounter;
1372    }

1374    protected static int GetSquallDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
1375            int amplitude,
1376            int quantity,
1377            int length,
1378            int numPoints) {
1379        int counter = 0;
1380        try {
1381            int j = 0, k = 0;
1382            POINT2 StartSegPt, EndSegPt;
1383            POINT2 savePoint1 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[0]);
1384            POINT2 savePoint2 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[numPoints - 1]);
1385            ref<int[]> sign = new ref();
1386            int segQty = 0;
1387            int totalQty = countsupport.GetSquallQty(pLinePoints, quantity, length, numPoints);
1388            POINT2[] pSquallPts = new POINT2[totalQty];
1389            POINT2[] pSquallSegPts = null;
1390
1391            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pSquallPts);
1392            sign.value = new int[1];
1393            sign.value[0] = -1;
1394            if (totalQty == 0) {
1395                return 0;
1396            }
1397
1398            for (j = 0; j < numPoints - 1; j++) {
1399                StartSegPt = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
1400                EndSegPt = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1401                segQty = countsupport.GetSquallSegQty(StartSegPt, EndSegPt, quantity, length);
1402                if (segQty > 0) {
1403                    pSquallSegPts = new POINT2[segQty];
1404                    lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pSquallSegPts);
1405                } else {
1406                    pSquallPts[counter].x = StartSegPt.x;
1407                    pSquallPts[counter++].y = StartSegPt.y;
1408                    pSquallPts[counter].x = EndSegPt.x;
1409                    pSquallPts[counter++].y = EndSegPt.y;
1410                    continue;
1411                }
1412                sign.value[0] = -1;
1413                lineutility.GetSquallSegment(StartSegPt, EndSegPt, pSquallSegPts, sign, amplitude, quantity, length);
1414                for (k = 0; k < segQty; k++) {
1415                    pSquallPts[counter].x = pSquallSegPts[k].x;
1416                    pSquallPts[counter].y = pSquallSegPts[k].y;
1417                    if (k == 0) {
1418                        pSquallPts[counter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
1419                    }
1420                    if (k == segQty - 1) {
1421                        pSquallPts[counter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1422                    }
1423                    pSquallPts[counter].style = 0;
1424                    counter++;
1425                }
1426            }
1427            //load the squall points into the linepoints array
1428            for (j = 0; j < counter; j++) {
1429                if (j < totalQty) {
1430                    pLinePoints[j].x = pSquallPts[j].x;
1431                    pLinePoints[j].y = pSquallPts[j].y;
1432                    if (j == 0) {
1433                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(savePoint1);
1434                    }
1435                    if (j == counter - 1) {
1436                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(savePoint2);
1437                    }
1438                    pLinePoints[j].style = pSquallPts[j].style;
1439                }
1440            }
1441            if (counter == 0) {
1442                for (j = 0; j < pLinePoints.length; j++) {
1443                    if (j == 0) {
1444                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(savePoint1);
1445                    } else {
1446                        pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(savePoint2);
1447                    }
1448                }
1449                counter = pLinePoints.length;
1450            }
1451        } catch (Exception exc) {
1452            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetSquallDouble",
1453                    new RendererException("GetSquallDouble", exc));
1454        }
1455        return counter;
1456    }

1458    protected static int GetSevereSquall(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
1459            int numPoints) {
1460        int l = 0;
1461        try {
1462            int quantity = 5, length = 30, j = 0, k = 0;
1463            int totalQty = countsupport.GetSquallQty(pLinePoints, quantity, length, numPoints) + 2 * numPoints;
1464            POINT2[] squallPts = new POINT2[totalQty];
1465            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(), pt1 = new POINT2(), pt2 = new POINT2(),
1466                    pt3 = new POINT2(), pt4 = new POINT2(), pt5 = new POINT2(), pt6 = new POINT2(),
1467                    pt7 = new POINT2(), pt8 = new POINT2();
1468            int segQty = 0;
1469            double dist = 0;
1470
1471            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(squallPts);
1472            //each segment looks like this: --- V
1473            for (j = 0; j < numPoints - 1; j++) {
1474                dist = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1475                segQty = (int) (dist / 30);
1476                for (k = 0; k < segQty; k++) {
1477                    pt0 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], k * 30);
1478                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], k * 30 + 20);
1479                    //pt0.style = 5;
1480                    pt5 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], k * 30 + 25);
1481                    pt6 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], k * 30 + 30);
1482                    //pt6.style=5;
1483                    pt2 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt1, pt1, 2, 5, 0);   //extend above line
1484                    pt3 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt5, pt5, 3, 5, 0);   //extend below line
1485                    pt4 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, pt6, pt6, 2, 5, 5);   //extend above line
1486                    pt4.style = 5;
1487                    squallPts[l++] = new POINT2(pt2);
1488                    squallPts[l++] = new POINT2(pt3);
1489                    squallPts[l++] = new POINT2(pt4);
1490                    pt7 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], k * 30 + 5);
1491                    pt8 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pLinePoints[j], pLinePoints[j + 1], k * 30 + 10);
1492                    pt8.style = 5;
1493                    squallPts[l++] = new POINT2(pt7);
1494                    squallPts[l++] = new POINT2(pt8);
1495                }
1496                //segment remainder
1497                squallPts[l++] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
1498                pt0 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pLinePoints[j + 1], pLinePoints[j], 5);
1499                pt0.style = 5;
1500                squallPts[l++] = new POINT2(pt0);
1501            }
1502            if (l > pLinePoints.length) {
1503                l = pLinePoints.length;
1504            }
1505
1506            for (j = 0; j < l; j++) {
1507                if (j < totalQty) {
1508                    pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(squallPts[j]);
1509                } else {
1510                    break;
1511                }
1512            }
1513
1514        } catch (Exception exc) {
1515            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetSevereSquall",
1516                    new RendererException("GetSevereSquall", exc));
1517        }
1518        return l;
1519    }

1521    private static int GetConvergancePointsDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints, int vblCounter) {
1522        int counter = vblCounter;
1523        try {
1524            int j = 0, k = 0;
1525            double d = 0;
1526            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(), pt1 = new POINT2();
1527            POINT2[] tempPts = new POINT2[vblCounter];
1528            POINT2 tempPt = new POINT2();
1529            int numJags = 0;
1530            //save the original points
1531            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter; j++) {
1532                tempPts[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
1533            }
1534
1535            //result points begin with the original points,
1536            //set the last one's linestyle to 5;
1537            pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1].style = 5;
1538            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
1539
1540                pt0 = new POINT2(tempPts[j]);
1541                pt1 = new POINT2(tempPts[j + 1]);
1542                d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
1543                numJags = (int) (d / 10);
1544                //we don't want too small a remainder
1545                if (d - numJags * 10 < 5) {
1546                    numJags -= 1;
1547                }
1548
1549                //each 10 pixel section has two spikes: one points above the line
1550                //the other spike points below the line
1551                for (k = 0; k < numJags; k++) {
1552                    //the first spike
1553                    tempPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt0, pt1, k * 10 + 5, 0);
1554                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(tempPt);
1555                    tempPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(tempPt, pt1, 5);
1556                    tempPt = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, tempPt, tempPt, 2, 5, 5);
1557                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(tempPt);
1558                    //the 2nd spike
1559                    tempPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt0, pt1, (k + 1) * 10, 0);
1560                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(tempPt);
1561                    tempPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(tempPt, pt1, 5);
1562                    tempPt = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0, tempPt, tempPt, 3, 5, 5);
1563                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(tempPt);
1564                }
1565            }
1566        } catch (Exception exc) {
1567            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetConvergancePointsDouble",
1568                    new RendererException("GetConvergancePointsDouble", exc));
1569        }
1570        return counter;
1571    }

1573    private static int GetITDPointsDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints, int vblCounter) {
1574        int counter = 0;
1575        try {
1576            int j = 0, k = 0;
1577            double d = 0;
1578            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(), pt1 = new POINT2();
1579            POINT2[] tempPts = new POINT2[vblCounter];
1580            POINT2 tempPt = new POINT2();
1581            int numJags = 0, lineStyle = 19;
1582            //save the original points
1583            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter; j++) {
1584                tempPts[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
1585            }
1586
1587            //result points begin with the original points,
1588            //set the last one's linestyle to 5;
1589            //pLinePoints[vblCounter-1].style=5;
1590            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
1591                pt0 = new POINT2(tempPts[j]);
1592                pt1 = new POINT2(tempPts[j + 1]);
1593                d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
1594                numJags = (int) (d / 15);
1595                //we don't want too small a remainder
1596                if (d - numJags * 10 < 5) {
1597                    numJags -= 1;
1598                }
1599                if (numJags == 0) {
1600                    pt0.style = 19;
1601                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt0);
1602                    pt1.style = 5;
1603                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt1);
1604                }
1605                //each 10 pixel section has two spikes: one points above the line
1606                //the other spike points below the line
1607                for (k = 0; k < numJags; k++) {
1608                    tempPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt0, pt1, k * 15 + 5, lineStyle);
1609                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(tempPt);
1610
1611                    if (k < numJags - 1) {
1612                        tempPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(tempPt, pt1, 10, 5);
1613                    } else {
1614                        tempPt = new POINT2(tempPts[j + 1]);
1615                        tempPt.style = 5;
1616                    }
1617                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(tempPt);
1618                    if (lineStyle == 19) {
1619                        lineStyle = 25;
1620                    } else {
1621                        lineStyle = 19;
1622                    }
1623                }
1624            }
1625        } catch (Exception exc) {
1626            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetITDPointsDouble",
1627                    new RendererException("GetITDPointsDouble", exc));
1628        }
