1632    private static int GetXPoints(int linetype, POINT2[] pOriginalLinePoints, POINT2[] XPoints, int vblCounter) {
1633        int xCounter = 0;
1634        try {
1635            int j = 0, k = 0;
1636            double d = 0;
1637            POINT2 pt0, pt1, pt2, pt3 = new POINT2(), pt4 = new POINT2(), pt5 = new POINT2(), pt6 = new POINT2();
1638            int numThisSegment = 0;
1639            double distInterval = 0;
1640            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
1641                d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1]);
1642                numThisSegment = (int) ((d - 20d) / 20d);
1643                if (linetype == TacticalLines.LRO) {
1644                    numThisSegment = (int) ((d - 30d) / 30d);
1645                }
1646                //added 4-19-12
1647                distInterval = d / numThisSegment;
1648                for (k = 0; k < numThisSegment; k++) {
1649                    //pt0=lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pOriginalLinePoints[j],pOriginalLinePoints[j+1], 10+20*k);
1650                    pt0 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1], distInterval / 2 + distInterval * k);
1651                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1], 5);
1652                    pt2 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1], -5);
1653
1654                    pt3 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pt1, pt1, 2, 5);
1655                    pt4 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pt1, pt1, 3, 5);
1656                    pt4.style = 5;
1657                    pt5 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pt2, pt2, 2, 5);
1658                    pt6 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pt2, pt2, 3, 5);
1659                    pt6.style = 5;
1660                    XPoints[xCounter++] = new POINT2(pt3);
1661                    XPoints[xCounter++] = new POINT2(pt6);
1662                    XPoints[xCounter++] = new POINT2(pt5);
1663                    XPoints[xCounter++] = new POINT2(pt4);
1664                }
1665            }
1666        } catch (Exception exc) {
1667            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetXPointsDouble",
1668                    new RendererException("GetXPointsDouble", exc));
1669        }
1670        return xCounter;
1671    }

1673    /**
1674     * returns a 37 point ellipse
1675     *
1676     * @param ptCenter
1677     * @param ptWidth
1678     * @param ptHeight
1679     * @return
1680     */
1681    private static POINT2[] getEllipsePoints(POINT2 ptCenter, POINT2 ptWidth, POINT2 ptHeight) {
1682        POINT2[] pEllipsePoints = null;
1683        try {
1684            pEllipsePoints = new POINT2[37];
1685            int l = 0;
1686            double dFactor = 0;
1687            double a = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptCenter, ptWidth);
1688            double b = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptCenter, ptHeight);
1689            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pEllipsePoints);
1690            for (l = 1; l < 37; l++) {
1691                dFactor = (10.0 * l) * Math.PI / 180.0;
1692                pEllipsePoints[l - 1].x = ptCenter.x + (int) (a * Math.cos(dFactor));
1693                pEllipsePoints[l - 1].y = ptCenter.y + (int) (b * Math.sin(dFactor));
1694                pEllipsePoints[l - 1].style = 0;
1695            }
1696            pEllipsePoints[36] = new POINT2(pEllipsePoints[0]);
1697        } catch (Exception exc) {
1698            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetEllipsePoints",
1699                    new RendererException("GetEllipsePoints", exc));
1700        }
1701        return pEllipsePoints;
1702    }

1704    /**
1705     * Calculate an ellipse and rotate about it's center by azimuth in degrees
1706     *
1707     * @param ptCenter
1708     * @param ptWidth
1709     * @param ptHeight
1710     * @param azimuth
1711     * @return
1712     */
1713    private static POINT2[] getRotatedEllipsePoints(POINT2 ptCenter, POINT2 ptWidth, POINT2 ptHeight, double azimuth, int lineType) {
1714        POINT2[] pResultPoints = null;
1715        try {
1716            POINT2[] pEllipsePoints = new POINT2[36];
1717            int l = 0, j = 0;
1718            double dFactor = 0;
1719            double a = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptCenter, ptWidth);
1720            double b = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(ptCenter, ptHeight);
1721//            if(lineType==TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE)
1722//                b=a;
1723            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pEllipsePoints);
1724            for (l = 1; l < 37; l++) {
1725                dFactor = (10.0 * l) * Math.PI / 180.0;
1726                //pEllipsePoints[l - 1].x = ptCenter.x + (int) (a * Math.cos(dFactor));
1727                //pEllipsePoints[l - 1].y = ptCenter.y + (int) (b * Math.sin(dFactor));
1728                pEllipsePoints[l - 1].x = ptCenter.x + a * Math.cos(dFactor);
1729                pEllipsePoints[l - 1].y = ptCenter.y + b * Math.sin(dFactor);
1730                pEllipsePoints[l - 1].style = 0;
1731            }
1732            if (lineType != TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE) {
1733                lineutility.RotateGeometryDouble(pEllipsePoints, 36, azimuth - 90);
1734            }
1735            pResultPoints = new POINT2[37];
1736            for (j = 0; j < 36; j++) {
1737                pResultPoints[j] = pEllipsePoints[j];
1738            }
1739            pResultPoints[36] = pEllipsePoints[0];
1740        } catch (Exception exc) {
1741            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetRotatedEllipsePoints",
1742                    new RendererException("GetRotatedEllipsePoints", exc));
1743        }
1744        return pResultPoints;
1745    }

1747    private static int GetLVOPoints(int linetype, POINT2[] pOriginalLinePoints, POINT2[] pLinePoints, int vblCounter) {
1748        int lEllipseCounter = 0;
1749        try {
1750            double dAngle = 0, d = 0, a = 4, b = 8, dFactor = 0;
1751            int lHowManyThisSegment = 0, j = 0, k = 0, l = 0, t = 0;
1752            POINT2 ptCenter = new POINT2();
1753            POINT2[] pEllipsePoints2 = new POINT2[37];
1754
1755            double distInterval = 0;
1756            //end declarations
1757            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
1758                lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(pEllipsePoints2);
1759                d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1]);
1760                lHowManyThisSegment = (int) ((d - 20) / 20);
1761                if (linetype == TacticalLines.LRO) {
1762                    lHowManyThisSegment = (int) ((d - 30) / 30);
1763                }
1764                distInterval = d / lHowManyThisSegment;
1765
1766                dAngle = lineutility.CalcSegmentAngleDouble(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1]);
1767                dAngle = dAngle + Math.PI / 2;
1768                for (k = 0; k < lHowManyThisSegment; k++) {
1769                    ptCenter = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pOriginalLinePoints[j], pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1], k * distInterval);
1770                    for (l = 1; l < 37; l++) {
1771                        //dFactor = (10.0 * l) * Math.PI / 180.0;
1772                        dFactor = (20.0 * l) * Math.PI / 180.0;
1773                        pEllipsePoints2[l - 1].x = ptCenter.x + (int) (a * Math.cos(dFactor));
1774                        pEllipsePoints2[l - 1].y = ptCenter.y + (int) (b * Math.sin(dFactor));
1775                        pEllipsePoints2[l - 1].style = 0;
1776                    }
1777                    lineutility.RotateGeometryDouble(pEllipsePoints2, 36, (int) (dAngle * 180 / Math.PI));
1778                    pEllipsePoints2[36] = new POINT2(pEllipsePoints2[35]);
1779                    pEllipsePoints2[36].style = 5;
1780                    for (l = 0; l < 37; l++) {
1781                        pLinePoints[lEllipseCounter] = new POINT2(pEllipsePoints2[l]);
1782                        lEllipseCounter++;
1783                    }
1784                }//end k loop
1785                //extra ellipse on the final segment at the end of the line
1786                if (j == vblCounter - 2) {
1787                    ptCenter = pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1];
1788
1789                    for (l = 1; l < 37; l++) {
1790                        dFactor = (20.0 * l) * Math.PI / 180.0;
1791                        pEllipsePoints2[l - 1].x = ptCenter.x + (int) (a * Math.cos(dFactor));
1792                        pEllipsePoints2[l - 1].y = ptCenter.y + (int) (b * Math.sin(dFactor));
1793                        pEllipsePoints2[l - 1].style = 0;
1794                    }
1795                    lineutility.RotateGeometryDouble(pEllipsePoints2, 36, (int) (dAngle * 180 / Math.PI));
1796                    pEllipsePoints2[36] = new POINT2(pEllipsePoints2[35]);
1797                    pEllipsePoints2[36].style = 5;
1798                    for (l = 0; l < 37; l++) {
1799                        pLinePoints[lEllipseCounter] = new POINT2(pEllipsePoints2[l]);
1800                        lEllipseCounter++;
1801                    }
1802                }
1803            }
1804        } catch (Exception exc) {
1805            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetLVOPointsDouble",
1806                    new RendererException("GetLVOPointsDouble", exc));
1807        }
1808        return lEllipseCounter;
1809    }

1811    private static int GetIcingPointsDouble(POINT2[] pLinePoints, int vblCounter) {
1812        int counter = 0;
1813        try {
1814            int j = 0;
1815            POINT2[] origPoints = new POINT2[vblCounter];
1816            int nDirection = -1;
1817            int k = 0, numSegments = 0;
1818            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(), pt1 = new POINT2(), midPt = new POINT2(), pt2 = new POINT2();
1819            //save the original points
1820            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter; j++) {
1821                origPoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
1822            }
1823            double distInterval = 0;
1824            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
1825                //how many segments for this line segment?
1826                numSegments = (int) lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(origPoints[j], origPoints[j + 1]);
1827                numSegments /= 15;      //segments are 15 pixels long
1828                //4-19-12
1829                distInterval = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(origPoints[j], origPoints[j + 1]) / numSegments;
1830                //get the direction and the quadrant
1831                nDirection = GetInsideOutsideDouble2(origPoints[j], origPoints[j + 1], origPoints, vblCounter, j, TacticalLines.ICING);
1832                for (k = 0; k < numSegments; k++) {
1833                    //get the parallel segment
1834                    if (k == 0) {
1835                        pt0 = new POINT2(origPoints[j]);
1836                    } else {
1837                        pt0 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(origPoints[j], origPoints[j + 1], k * distInterval, 0);
1838                    }
1839
1840                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(origPoints[j], origPoints[j + 1], k * distInterval + 10, 5);
1841                    midPt = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(origPoints[j], origPoints[j + 1], k * distInterval + 5, 0);
1842                    //get the perpendicular segment
1843                    pt2 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(origPoints[j], origPoints[j + 1], midPt, nDirection, 5, 5);
1844                    pLinePoints[counter] = new POINT2(pt0);
1845                    pLinePoints[counter + 1] = new POINT2(pt1);
1846                    pLinePoints[counter + 2] = new POINT2(midPt);
1847                    pLinePoints[counter + 3] = new POINT2(pt2);
1848                    counter += 4;
1849                }
1850            }
1851        } catch (Exception exc) {
1852            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetIcingPointsDouble",
1853                    new RendererException("GetIcingPointsDouble", exc));
1854        }
1855        return counter;
1856    }

1858    protected static int GetAnchorageDouble(POINT2[] vbPoints2, int numPts) {
1859        int lFlotCounter = 0;
1860        try {
1861            int j = 0, k = 0, l = 0;
1862            int x1 = 0, y1 = 0;
1863            int numSegPts = -1;
1864            int lFlotCount = 0;
1865            int lNumSegs = 0;
1866            double dDistance = 0;
1867            int[] vbPoints = null;
1868            int[] points = null;
1869            int[] points2 = null;
1870            POINT2 pt = new POINT2();
1871            POINT2 pt1 = new POINT2(), pt2 = new POINT2();
1872
1873            lFlotCount = flot.GetAnchorageCountDouble(vbPoints2, numPts);
1874            vbPoints = new int[2 * numPts];
1875
1876            for (j = 0; j < numPts; j++) {
1877                vbPoints[k] = (int) vbPoints2[j].x;
1878                k++;
1879                vbPoints[k] = (int) vbPoints2[j].y;
1880                k++;
1881            }
1882            k = 0;
1883
1884            ref<int[]> bFlip = new ref();
1885            bFlip.value = new int[1];
1886            ref<int[]> lDirection = new ref();
1887            lDirection.value = new int[1];
1888            ref<int[]> lLastDirection = new ref();
1889            lLastDirection.value = new int[1];
1890            for (l = 0; l < numPts - 1; l++) {
1891                pt1.x = vbPoints[2 * l];
1892                pt1.y = vbPoints[2 * l + 1];
1893                pt2.x = vbPoints[2 * l + 2];
1894                pt2.y = vbPoints[2 * l + 3];
1895                //for all segments after the first segment we shorten
1896                //the line by 20 so the flots will not abut
1897                if (l > 0) {
1898                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt1, pt2, 20);
1899                }
1900
1901                dDistance = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt1, pt2);
1902
1903                lNumSegs = (int) (dDistance / 20);
1904
1905                if (lNumSegs > 0) {
1906                    points2 = new int[lNumSegs * 32];
1907                    numSegPts = flot.GetAnchorageFlotSegment(vbPoints, (int) pt1.x, (int) pt1.y, (int) pt2.x, (int) pt2.y, l, points2, bFlip, lDirection, lLastDirection);
1908                    points = new int[numSegPts];
1909
1910                    for (j = 0; j < numSegPts; j++) {
1911                        points[j] = points2[j];
1912                    }
1913
1914                    for (j = 0; j < numSegPts / 3; j++) //only using half the flots
1915                    {
1916                        x1 = points[k];
1917                        y1 = points[k + 1];
1918                        k += 3;
1919                        if (j % 10 == 0) {
1920                            pt.x = x1;
1921                            pt.y = y1;
1922                            pt.style = 5;
1923                        } else if ((j + 1) % 10 == 0) {
1924                            if (lFlotCounter < lFlotCount) {
1925                                vbPoints2[lFlotCounter].x = x1;
1926                                vbPoints2[lFlotCounter++].y = y1;
1927                                vbPoints2[lFlotCounter++] = new POINT2(pt);
1928                                continue;
1929                            } else {
1930                                break;
1931                            }
1932                        }
1933                        if (lFlotCounter < lFlotCount) {
1934                            vbPoints2[lFlotCounter].x = x1;
1935                            vbPoints2[lFlotCounter].y = y1;
1936                            lFlotCounter++;
1937                        } else {
1938                            break;
1939                        }
1940                    }
1941                    k = 0;
1942                    points = null;
1943                } else {
1944                    if (lFlotCounter < lFlotCount) {
1945                        vbPoints2[lFlotCounter].x = vbPoints[2 * l];
1946                        vbPoints2[lFlotCounter].y = vbPoints[2 * l + 1];
1947                        lFlotCounter++;
1948                    }
1949                }
1950            }
1951            for (j = lFlotCounter - 1; j < lFlotCount; j++) {
1952                vbPoints2[j].style = 5;
1953            }
1954
1955        } catch (Exception exc) {
1956            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetAnchorageDouble",
1957                    new RendererException("GetAnchorageDouble", exc));
1958        }
1959        return lFlotCounter;
1960    }

1962    private static int GetPipePoints(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
1963            int vblCounter) {
1964        int counter = 0;
1965        try {
1966            POINT2[] pOriginalPoints = new POINT2[vblCounter];
1967            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2();
1968            POINT2 pt1 = new POINT2();
1969            POINT2 pt2 = new POINT2();
1970            POINT2[] xPoints = new POINT2[pLinePoints.length];
1971            int xCounter = 0;
1972            int j = 0, k = 0;
1973            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter; j++) {
1974                pOriginalPoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
1975            }
1976            int numSegs = 0;
1977            double d = 0;
1978
1979            lineutility.InitializePOINT2Array(xPoints);
1980            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
1981                d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1]);
1982                numSegs = (int) (d / 20);
1983                for (k = 0; k < numSegs; k++) {
1984                    pt0 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 20 * k);
1985                    pt0.style = 0;
1986                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 20 * k + 10);
1987                    pt1.style = 5;
1988                    pt2 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 20 * k + 10);
1989                    pt2.style = 20;     //for filled circle
1990                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt0);
1991                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt1);
1992                    xPoints[xCounter++] = new POINT2(pt2);
1993                }
1994                if (numSegs == 0) {
1995                    pLinePoints[counter] = new POINT2(pOriginalPoints[j]);
1996                    pLinePoints[counter++].style = 0;
1997                    pLinePoints[counter] = new POINT2(pOriginalPoints[j + 1]);
1998                    pLinePoints[counter++].style = 5;
1999                } else {
2000                    pLinePoints[counter] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[counter - 1]);
2001                    pLinePoints[counter++].style = 0;
2002                    pLinePoints[counter] = new POINT2(pOriginalPoints[j + 1]);
2003                    pLinePoints[counter++].style = 5;
2004                }
2005            }
2006            //load the circle points
2007            for (k = 0; k < xCounter; k++) {
2008                pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(xPoints[k]);
2009            }
2010            //add one more circle
2011            pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[counter]);
2012
2013            pOriginalPoints = null;
2014            xPoints = null;
2015        } catch (Exception exc) {
2016            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetPipePoints",
2017                    new RendererException("GetPipePoints", exc));
2018        }
2019        return counter;
2020    }

2022    private static int GetReefPoints(POINT2[] pLinePoints,
2023            int vblCounter) {
2024        int counter = 0;
2025        try {
2026            POINT2[] pOriginalPoints = new POINT2[vblCounter];
2027            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2();
2028            POINT2 pt1 = new POINT2();
2029            POINT2 pt2 = new POINT2();
2030            POINT2 pt3 = new POINT2();
2031            POINT2 pt4 = new POINT2();
2032            //POINT2 pt5=new POINT2();
2033            for (int j = 0; j < vblCounter; j++) {
2034                pOriginalPoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
2035            }
2036
2037            int numSegs = 0, direction = 0;
2038            double d = 0;
2039            for (int j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
2040                if (pOriginalPoints[j].x < pOriginalPoints[j + 1].x) {
2041                    direction = 2;
2042                } else {
2043                    direction = 3;
2044                }
2045
2046                d = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1]);
2047                numSegs = (int) (d / 40);
2048                for (int k = 0; k < numSegs; k++) {
2049                    pt0 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 40 * k);
2050
2051                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 10);
2052                    pt1 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], pt1, direction, 15);//was 2
2053
2054                    pt2 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 20);
2055                    pt2 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], pt2, direction, 5);//was 2
2056
2057                    pt3 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pt0, pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 30);
2058                    pt3 = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], pt3, direction, 20);//was 2
2059
2060                    pt4 = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble2(pOriginalPoints[j], pOriginalPoints[j + 1], 40 * (k + 1));
2061                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt0);
2062                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt1);
2063                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt2);
2064                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt3);
2065                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pt4);
2066                }
2067                if (numSegs == 0) {
2068                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pOriginalPoints[j]);
2069                    pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pOriginalPoints[j + 1]);
2070                }
2071            }
2072            pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pOriginalPoints[vblCounter - 1]);
2073            pOriginalPoints = null;
2074        } catch (Exception exc) {
2075            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetReefPoints",
2076                    new RendererException("GetReefPoints", exc));
2077        }
2078        return counter;
2079    }

2124            pLinePoints[counter++] = new POINT2(pOriginalPoints[vblCounter - 1]);

2126            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetRestrictedAreaPoints",
2127                    new RendererException("GetRestrictedAreaPoints", exc));
2128        }
2129        return counter;
2130    }

2132    //there should be two linetypes depending on scale
2133    private static int getOverheadWire(POINT2[] pLinePoints, int vblCounter) {
2134        int counter = 0;
2135        try {
2136            int j = 0;
2137            POINT2 pt = null, pt2 = null;
2138            double x = 0, y = 0;
2139            ArrayList<POINT2> pts = new ArrayList();
2140            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter; j++) {
2141                pt = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
2142                x = pt.x;
2143                y = pt.y;
2144                //tower
2145                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2146                pt2.y -= 5;
2147                pts.add(pt2);
2148                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2149                pt2.x -= 5;
2150                pts.add(pt2);
2151                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2152                pt2.y -= 20;
2153                pts.add(pt2);
2154                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2155                pt2.x += 5;
2156                pts.add(pt2);
2157                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2158                pt2.y -= 5;
2159                pt2.style = 5;
2160                pts.add(pt2);
2161                //low cross piece
2162                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2163                pt2.x -= 2;
2164                pt2.y -= 10;
2165                pts.add(pt2);
2166                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2167                pt2.x += 2;
2168                pt2.y -= 10;
2169                pt2.style = 5;
2170                pts.add(pt2);
2171                //high cross piece
2172                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2173                pt2.x -= 7;
2174                pt2.y -= 17;
2175                pts.add(pt2);
2176                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2177                pt2.x -= 5;
2178                pt2.y -= 20;
2179                pts.add(pt2);
2180                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2181                pt2.x += 5;
2182                pt2.y -= 20;
2183                pts.add(pt2);
2184                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2185                pt2.x += 7;
2186                pt2.y -= 17;
2187                pt2.style = 5;
2188                pts.add(pt2);
2189                //angle piece
2190                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2191                pt2.y -= 20;
2192                pts.add(pt2);
2193                pt2 = new POINT2(pt);
2194                pt2.x += 8;
2195                pt2.y -= 12;
2196                pt2.style = 5;
2197                pts.add(pt2);
2198            }
2199            //connect the towers
2200            for (j = 0; j < vblCounter - 1; j++) {
2201                pt = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j]);
2202                pt2 = new POINT2(pLinePoints[j + 1]);
2203                if (pt.x < pt2.x) {
2204                    pt.x += 5;
2205                    pt.y -= 10;
2206                    pt2.x -= 5;
2207                    pt2.y -= 10;
2208                    pt2.style = 5;
2209                } else {
2210                    pt.x -= 5;
2211                    pt.y -= 10;
2212                    pt2.x += 5;
2213                    pt2.y -= 10;
2214                    pt2.style = 5;
2215                }
2216                pts.add(pt);
2217                pts.add(pt2);
2218            }
2219            for (j = 0; j < pts.size(); j++) {
2220                pLinePoints[j] = pts.get(j);
2221                counter++;
2222            }
2223            for (j = counter; j < pLinePoints.length; j++) {
2224                pLinePoints[j] = new POINT2(pLinePoints[counter - 1]);
2225            }
2226        } catch (Exception exc) {
2227            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetOverheadWire",
2228                    new RendererException("GetOverheadWire", exc));
2229        }
2230        return counter;
2231    }

2297
2298            POINT2 calcPoint0 = new POINT2(),
2299                    calcPoint1 = new POINT2(),
2300                    calcPoint2 = new POINT2(),
2301                    calcPoint3 = new POINT2(),
2302                    calcPoint4 = new POINT2();

2318            ArrayList xPoints = null;

2324            //resize the array and get the line array

2438                    for (j = 0; j < 3; j++) {

2457                    }

2470

2478
2479                    pt1 = new POINT2(pt0);

2505                    nQuadrant = lineutility.GetQuadrantDouble(pLinePoints[0], pLinePoints[1]);

2512                                case 2: //extend below
2513                                    break;
2514                                case 0: //extend right
2515                                case 3: //extend above
2516                                    lineutility.ReversePointsDouble2(pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter);
2517                                    break;
2518                                default:
2519                                    break;
2520                            }
2521                            break;
2522                        case 1:
2523                            switch (n) {
2524                                case 1: //extend left
2525                                case 3: //extend above
2526                                    break;
2527                                case 0: //extend right
2528                                case 2: //extend below
2529                                    lineutility.ReversePointsDouble2(pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter);

2531                                default:
2532                                    break;
2533                            }

2535                        case 2:
2536                            switch (n) {
2537                                case 1: //extend left
2538                                case 2: //extend below
2539                                    lineutility.ReversePointsDouble2(pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter);
2540                                    break;
2541                                case 0: //extend right
2542                                case 3: //extend above
2543                                    break;
2544                                default:
2545                                    break;
2546                            }
2547                            break;
2548                        case 3:
2549                            switch (n) {
2550                                case 1: //extend left
2551                                case 3: //extend above

2556                                    break;

2558                                    break;

2560                            break;

2604                case TacticalLines.MVFR:

2607                    nQuadrant = lineutility.GetQuadrantDouble(pLinePoints[0], pLinePoints[1]);
2608                    //if the direction and quadrant are not compatible with GetFlotDouble then
2609                    //reverse the points
2610                    switch (nQuadrant) {
2611                        case 4:
2612                            switch (n) {
2613                                case 0: //extend left
2614                                case 3: //extend below
2615                                    break;
2616                                case 1: //extend right
2617                                case 2: //extend above
2618                                    lineutility.ReversePointsDouble2(pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter);
2619                                    break;
2620                                default:
2621                                    break;
2622                            }
2623                            break;
2624                        case 1:
2625                            switch (n) {
2626                                case 0: //extend left
2627                                case 2: //extend above
2628                                    break;
2629                                case 1: //extend right
2630                                case 3: //extend below
2631                                    lineutility.ReversePointsDouble2(pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter);
2632                                    break;
2633                                default:
2634                                    break;
2635                            }
2636                            break;
2637                        case 2:
2638                            switch (n) {
2639                                case 0: //extend left
2640                                case 3: //extend below
2641                                    lineutility.ReversePointsDouble2(pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter);
2642                                    break;
2643                                case 1: //extend right
2644                                case 2: //extend above
2645                                    break;
2646                                default:
2647                                    break;
2648                            }
2649                            break;
2650                        case 3:
2651                            switch (n) {
2652                                case 0: //extend left
2653                                case 2: //extend above
2654                                    lineutility.ReversePointsDouble2(pLinePoints, vblSaveCounter);
2655                                    break;

2657                                case 3: //extend above

2667                    acCounter = lFlotCount;
2668                    break;

2674                    break;

2677                    acCounter = vblCounter;
2678                    break;
2679                case TacticalLines.TROUGH:
2680                case TacticalLines.INSTABILITY:
2681                case TacticalLines.SHEAR:
2682                    vblCounter = GetSquallDouble(pLinePoints, 10, 6, 30, vblSaveCounter);
2683                    acCounter = vblCounter;
2684                    break;
2685                case TacticalLines.SQUALL:

2687                    acCounter = vblCounter;
2688                    break;
2689                case TacticalLines.USF:
2690                case TacticalLines.SFG:
2691                case TacticalLines.SFY:

5214                            if (pLinePoints[k].style == 5 || pLinePoints[k].style == 10) {
5215                                beginLine = true;
5216                                //unless there are doubled points with style=5
5217                            }
5218                        }
5219                        if (k == acCounter - 4) //non-LC should only have one shape
5220                        {
5221                            if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5222                                shapes.add(shape);
5223                            }
5224                        }
5225                    }//end for
5226                    //last shape are the xpoints
5227                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5228                    shape.set_Style(1);
5229                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[acCounter - 1]);
5230                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[acCounter - 2]);
5231                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[acCounter - 3]);
5232                    if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5233                        shapes.add(shape);
5234                    }
5235                    break;
5236                case TacticalLines.DMA:
5237                    //first shape is the original points
5238                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5239                    shape.set_Style(pLinePoints[0].style);
5240                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[0]);
5241                    for (k = 1; k < vblCounter - 3; k++) {
5242                        shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5243                    }
5244                    if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5245                        shapes.add(shape);
5246                    }
5247                    //next shape is the center feature
5248                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5249                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[vblCounter - 3]);
5250                    shape.set_Style(1);
5251                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[vblCounter - 2]);
5252                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[vblCounter - 1]);
5253                    if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5254                        shapes.add(shape);
5255                    }
5256
5257                    break;
5258                case TacticalLines.FORDIF:
5259                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5260                    shape.set_Style(pLinePoints[0].style);
5261                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[0]);
5262                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[1]);
5263                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[2]);
5264                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[3]);
5265                    shapes.add(shape);
5266                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5267                    shape.set_Style(pLinePoints[4].style);
5268                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[4]);
5269                    for (k = 5; k < acCounter; k++) {
5270                        if (pLinePoints[k - 1].style != 5) {
5271                            shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5272                        }
5273                    }
5274
5275                    if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5276                        shapes.add(shape);
5277                    }
5278                    break;
5279                case TacticalLines.DMAF:
5280                    //first shape is the original points
5281                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5282                    shape.set_Style(points.get(0).style);
5283                    shape.moveTo(points.get(0));
5284                    for (k = 1; k < vblCounter - 3; k++) {
5285                        shape.lineTo(points.get(k));
5286                    }
5287                    if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5288                        shapes.add(shape);
5289                    }
5290                    //next shape is the center feature
5291                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5292                    shape.moveTo(points.get(vblCounter - 3));
5293                    shape.set_Style(1);
5294                    shape.lineTo(points.get(vblCounter - 2));
5295                    shape.lineTo(points.get(vblCounter - 1));
5296                    if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5297                        shapes.add(shape);
5298                    }
5299
5300                    //last shape are the xpoints
5301                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5302                    beginLine = true;
5303                    for (k = vblCounter; k < points.size(); k++) {
5304                        if (beginLine) {
5305                            if (k == 0) {
5306                                shape.set_Style(points.get(k).style);
5307                            }
5308
5309                            if (k > 0) //doubled points with linestyle=5
5310                            {
5311                                if (points.get(k).style == 5 && points.get(k - 1).style == 5) {
5312                                    shape.lineTo(points.get(k));
5313                                }
5314                            }
5315
5316                            shape.moveTo(points.get(k));
5317                            beginLine = false;
5318                        } else {
5319                            shape.lineTo(points.get(k));
5320                            if (points.get(k).style == 5 || points.get(k).style == 10) {
5321                                beginLine = true;
5322                                //unless there are doubled points with style=5
5323                            }
5324                        }
5325                        if (k == points.size() - 1) //non-LC should only have one shape
5326                        {
5327                            if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5328                                shapes.add(shape);
5329                            }
5330                        }
5331                    }
5332                    break;
5333                case TacticalLines.AIRFIELD:
5334                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5335                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[0]);
5336                    for (k = 1; k < acCounter - 5; k++) {
5337                        shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5338                    }
5339
5340                    shapes.add(shape);
5341
5342                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5343                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[acCounter - 4]);
5344                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[acCounter - 3]);
5345                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[acCounter - 2]);
5346                    shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[acCounter - 1]);
5347                    shapes.add(shape);
5348                    break;
5349                case TacticalLines.MIN_POINTS:
5350                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5351                    shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[0]);
5352                    for (k = 1; k < pLinePoints.length; k++) {
5353                        shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5354                    }
5355
5356                    shapes.add(shape);
5357                    break;
5358                default:
5359                    for (k = 0; k < acCounter; k++) {
5360                        //use shapes instead of pixels
5361                        if (shape == null) {
5362                            shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5363                        }
5364
5365                        if (beginLine) {
5366
5367                            if (k == 0) {
5368                                shape.set_Style(pLinePoints[k].style);
5369                            }
5370
5371                            if (k > 0) //doubled points with linestyle=5
5372                            {
5373                                if (pLinePoints[k].style == 5 && pLinePoints[k - 1].style == 5 && k < acCounter - 1) {
5374                                    continue;
5375                                } else if (pLinePoints[k].style == 5 && pLinePoints[k - 1].style == 10) //CF
5376                                {
5377                                    continue;
5378                                }
5379                            }
5380
5381                            if (k == 0 && pLinePoints.length > 1) {
5382                                if (pLinePoints[k].style == 5 && pLinePoints[k + 1].style == 5) {
5383                                    continue;
5384                                }
5385                            }
5386
5387                            shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5388                            beginLine = false;
5389                        } else {
5390                            shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5391                            if (pLinePoints[k].style == 5 || pLinePoints[k].style == 10) {
5392                                beginLine = true;
5393                                //unless there are doubled points with style=5
5394                            }
5395                        }
5396                        if (k == acCounter - 1) //non-LC should only have one shape
5397                        {
5398                            if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5399                                shapes.add(shape);
5400                            }
5401                        }
5402                    }//end for
5403                    break;
5404            }//end switch
5405            //a loop for arrowheads with fill
5406            //these require a separate shape for fill
5407            switch (lineType) {
5408                case TacticalLines.AC:
5409                case TacticalLines.SAAFR:
5410                case TacticalLines.MRR:
5411                case TacticalLines.MRR_USAS:
5412                case TacticalLines.UAV:
5413                case TacticalLines.UAV_USAS:
5414                case TacticalLines.LLTR:
5415                    for (j = 0; j < vblSaveCounter - 1; j++) {
5416                        dMBR = pOriginalLinePoints[j].style;
5417                        acPoints[0] = new POINT2(pOriginalLinePoints[j]);
5418                        acPoints[1] = new POINT2(pOriginalLinePoints[j + 1]);
5419                        lineutility.GetSAAFRFillSegment(acPoints, dMBR);//was dMRR
5420                        shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
5421                        shape.moveTo(acPoints[0]);
5422                        shape.lineTo(acPoints[1]);
5423                        shape.lineTo(acPoints[2]);
5424                        shape.lineTo(acPoints[3]);
5425                        shapes.add(0, shape);
5426                    }
5427                    break;
5428                case TacticalLines.BELT1://requires non-decorated fill shape
5429                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
5430                    shape.moveTo(pUpperLinePoints[0]);
5431                    for (j = 1; j < pUpperLinePoints.length; j++) {
5432                        shape.lineTo(pUpperLinePoints[j]);
5433                    }
5434                    shape.lineTo(pLowerLinePoints[pLowerLinePoints.length - 1]);
5435                    for (j = pLowerLinePoints.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
5436                        shape.lineTo(pLowerLinePoints[j]);
5437                    }
5438                    shape.lineTo(pUpperLinePoints[0]);
5439                    shapes.add(0, shape);
5440                    break;
5441                case TacticalLines.DIRATKAIR:
5442                    //added this section to not fill the bow tie and instead
5443                    //add a shape to close what had been the bow tie fill areas with
5444                    //a line segment for each one
5445                    int outLineCounter = 0;
5446                    POINT2[] ptOutline = new POINT2[4];
5447                    for (k = 0; k < acCounter; k++) {
5448                        if (pLinePoints[k].style == 10) {
5449                            shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
5450                            shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[k - 2]);
5451                            shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5452                            if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5453                                shapes.add(1, shape);
5454                            }
5455
5456                            //collect these four points
5457                            ptOutline[outLineCounter++] = pLinePoints[k - 2];
5458                            ptOutline[outLineCounter++] = pLinePoints[k];
5459                        }
5460                    }//end for
5461                    break;
5462                case TacticalLines.OFY:
5463                case TacticalLines.OCCLUDED:
5464                case TacticalLines.WF:
5465                case TacticalLines.WFG:
5466                case TacticalLines.WFY:
5467                case TacticalLines.CF:
5468                case TacticalLines.CFY:
5469                case TacticalLines.CFG:
5470                case TacticalLines.SARA:
5471                case TacticalLines.FERRY:
5472                case TacticalLines.EASY:
5473                case TacticalLines.BYDIF:
5474                case TacticalLines.BYIMP:
5475                case TacticalLines.FOLSP:
5476                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHC:
5477                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHM:
5478                case TacticalLines.MNFLDFIX:
5479                case TacticalLines.TURN:
5480                case TacticalLines.MNFLDDIS:
5481                    //POINT2 initialFillPt=null;
5482                    for (k = 0; k < acCounter; k++) {
5483                        if (k == 0) {
5484                            if (pLinePoints[k].style == 9) {
5485                                shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
5486                                shape.set_Style(pLinePoints[k].style);
5487                                shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5488                            }
5489                        } else //k>0
5490                        {
5491                            if (pLinePoints[k].style == 9 && pLinePoints[k - 1].style != 9) {
5492                                shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
5493                                shape.set_Style(pLinePoints[k].style);
5494                                shape.moveTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5495                            }
5496                            if (pLinePoints[k].style == 9 && pLinePoints[k - 1].style == 9) //9,9,...,9,10
5497                            {
5498                                shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5499                            }
5500                        }
5501                        if (pLinePoints[k].style == 10) {
5502                            shape.lineTo(pLinePoints[k]);
5503                            if (shape != null && shape.getShape() != null) {
5504                                shapes.add(0, shape);
5505                            }
5506                        }
5507                    }//end for
5508                    break;
5509                default:
5510                    break;
5511            }
5512        } catch (Exception exc) {
5513            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetLineArray2Double",
5514                    new RendererException("GetLineArray2Dboule " + Integer.toString(lineType), exc));
